question_stem:
Two parallel vertical metal plates are connected to a power supply, as shown in Fig. 6.1.
The separation of the plates is 16 mm.
question_stem_latex:
Two parallel vertical metal plates are connected to a power supply, as shown in Fig. 6.1.
The separation of the plates is 16 mm.

parts.label: (a)
parts.question_text: On Fig. 6.1, draw at least six field lines to represent the electric field between the plates.
parts.question_text_latex: On Fig. 6.1, draw at least six field lines to represent the electric field between the plates.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
An α-particle travels in a vacuum between the two plates.
The electric field does work on the α-particle. The gain in kinetic energy of the α-particle is
15 keV.
Calculate the electric field strength between the plates.
electric field strength = V m^{-1}
